description.p: Matterleast is an unofficial client for Mattermost servers with a feel closer to Discord. It signs in with a password or single sign-on and keeps several servers side by side.

ul.li: One Home inbox for unread messages, mentions, threads and saved messages across all servers
Threads, reactions, custom emoji, file previews and search
Notifications while the app runs, and the unread count in the tray
Matterleast colours or your server's theme, in light and dark mode

description.p: Matterleast is not affiliated with or endorsed by Mattermost, Inc.
